name: HTTP Request
description: Send an HTTP request to any API endpoint.

properties.name: sendHeaders
properties.description: Enable to add custom HTTP headers to the request

properties.name: headersCollection
properties.description: HTTP headers to send with the request

fields.name: key
fields.description: Name of the HTTP header (e.g., Authorization, Content-Type)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value for this header. Can use {{data.field}} to reference input data

properties.name: sendQueryParams
properties.description: Enable to add query parameters to the URL

properties.name: queryParams
properties.description: Query parameters to append to the URL

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value for this parameter. Can use {{data.field}}

properties.name: responseType
properties.description: How to handle the response. Auto-detect will determine based on Content-Type header.
